title: Steven Odell Joins Tesorio as VP of Revenue Transformation
summary: Steven Odell joins Tesorio as VP of Revenue Transformation, bringing firsthand experience as a customer at Slack and Contentful.
body_markdown:
Before Steven Odell joined Tesorio, he was our customer at Slack and Contentful. He was also the person who gave Carlos a line we still come back to: “Revenue ain’t real till it’s paid.”


Today, we’re welcoming Steven as our VP of Revenue Transformation.


Our relationship started seven years ago. Carlos and Steven spoke on a Monday. By the end of that week, Carlos was on a plane to meet him. They shared a view of cash flow as a data problem, and of collections as part of the customer experience. That perspective has stayed with us as we’ve built Tesorio.


“Years later, having him on our team feels like coming full circle,” says Carlos R. Vega, our CEO and Co-Founder. “He brings the experience of someone who’s been responsible for getting paid at leading companies, and now he’s helping our customers put AI agents to work toward that same goal.”


Steven knows what that responsibility looks like in practice.


“At Slack, I led credit and collections for a business approaching $1 billion in annual revenue with a team of just two, while maintaining less than 5% of receivables over 30 days past due,” Steven says. “That experience reinforced something I’ve believed throughout my career: successful revenue operations aren’t about adding more people or technology. They’re about designing the right processes, establishing accountability, and making intelligent decisions about where people create the most value.”


At Tesorio, Steven will lead our customer organization and work directly with finance leaders to understand what’s slowing down payment. Through portfolio reviews, advisory conversations, and workshops, he’ll help teams improve their processes and decide where AI agents can take on repeatable work while people handle the decisions that need their judgment. He’ll also help our customer community exchange practical lessons from that work.


We’re glad to have him here.


Read the[full announcement on CFO Dive](https://www.cfodive.com/press-release/20261117-tesorio-appoints-steven-odell-as-vp-of-revenue-transformation-to-advance-ag-1/) .[Explore upcoming Tesorio Live sessions and events](https://www.tesorio.com/events) .
